To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) food absence is a cue that induces metamorphosis in the solitary bee O. lignaria; 2) the absence of critical weight in O. ligna- ria is likely due to a secondary mechanism that induces metamorpho- sis when provisions are not fully consumed; and 3) precocene treatment can induce metamorphosis in larvae that have not consumed all of their provisions.
